epistemic_laws: Seal the evidence, not the thinking.
Representation may become richer than the source; the knowledge claim may never become richer than the evidence.
One Free World. Many sealed observations. One evidence law.
Direct-CFA/source evidence remains immutable and sealed.
Single physical-frame provenance remains single-frame provenance.
Source capability is not proof of measured sample domain.
Scientific Master remains separate from export/presentation.
Unknown remains a valid state and may not silently become zero or certainty.
More precision, more raster samples or faster computation never creates authority or evidence.
APK/GCam/computational RAW may not determine D.RAW evidence, calibration or Scientific-Master authority.
No AI/ML/neural/generative runtime belongs in the scientific path.
